reuse.why: Extends the shared getScheduledAmount and computes the tolerance with the existing getApproxNumberThreshold from shared/rules, the same helper rule matching uses.

duplication.why: The tolerance and the worst-case rule each live once; callers only pass their operator.

placement.why: The rule stays in shared/schedules.ts and reuses the shared rules helper rather than restating 7.5%.

scope.why: Every caller is threaded with the operator, including display-only UI cells and the edit reducer's op-switch seeding, which changes what those screens show beyond planning.

maintainability.why: One definition with an explicit op argument; inserting op before the existing inverse positional parameter is a slightly awkward signature change that every inverse caller must track.

one_place.where: packages/loot-core/src/shared/schedules.ts getScheduledAmount (using getApproxNumberThreshold), called with the operator by preview, posting, action sync, forecast, budget templates, the API list and the UI.
